DeshFiles selective compression engine

This implementation is adapted from compress-pdf-lib version 1.0.5,
licensed under the MIT License. The upstream package is available at:
https://github.com/dgbkn/compress-pdf-lib

The local adaptation is maintained by DeshFiles to classify image XObjects
before decoding. Images with /SMask, /Mask, or /ImageMask are preserved
unchanged; supported opaque images are recompressed in place. This local
engine uses pdf-lib 1.17.1 and the upstream package's public CompressionPool
for optional JPEG worker encoding.
